name: io.github.chrischall/office-outlook-mcp
description: Outlook / Microsoft 365 for Claude — mail, calendar, contacts and tasks, with confirm-gated sending

environmentVariables.name: OUTLOOK_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Pre-obtained Outlook bearer token. Overrides the browser bridge. Power users / CI only; tokens last about 25 hours.

environmentVariables.name: OUTLOOK_DISABLE_FETCHPROXY
environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to disable browser capture, requiring OUTLOOK_ACCESS_TOKEN.

environmentVariables.name: OUTLOOK_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Override the Outlook REST base URL. Defaults to https://outlook.office.com/api/v2.0.

environmentVariables.name: OUTLOOK_WS_PORT
environmentVariables.description: fetchproxy concentrator port used for token capture. Defaults to 37149, the fleet-wide shared port.

environmentVariables.name: OUTLOOK_CAPTURE_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Seconds to wait for the Outlook tab to make a request we can read a token from. Defaults to 30.

environmentVariables.name: OUTLOOK_TOKEN_CACHE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'false' to stop caching the captured token between runs. Defaults to true.

environmentVariables.name: OUTLOOK_TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to the cached token file. Defaults to ~/.office-outlook-mcp/token.json.
